description: This file is a test harness for the voice call manager, including mock provider implementation, helper functions for creating test data, and functions to simulate call events and store data.

classes.name: FakeProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of the VoiceCallProvider interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: createTestStorePath
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for storing call data during tests.

methods.name: createManagerHarness
methods.description: Initializes a CallManager instance with a fake provider and returns it along with the provider.

methods.name: markCallAnswered
methods.description: Simulates a call being answered by processing a call.answered event.

methods.name: writeCallsToStore
methods.description: Writes an array of call records to a JSONL file in the specified store path.

methods.name: makePersistedCall
methods.description: Generates a mock call record with default or overridden properties for testing.
